/bin/bash -lc "cat > [REDACTED LOCAL PATH] <<'EOF'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Seurat))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Matrix))
x <- readRDS('mats.rds')
obj1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts=x"'$mat1, project='"'s1', min.cells=0, min.features=0)
obj2 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts=x"'$mat2, project='"'s2', min.cells=0, min.features=0)
obj1"'$sample <- '"'sample1'; obj2"'$sample <- '"'sample2'
obj1 <- NormalizeData(obj1, verbose=FALSE)
obj2 <- NormalizeData(obj2, verbose=FALSE)
obj1 <- FindVariableFeatures(obj1, selection.method='vst', nfeatures=2000, verbose=FALSE)
obj2 <- FindVariableFeatures(obj2, selection.method='vst', nfeatures=2000, verbose=FALSE)
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list=list(obj1,obj2), nfeatures=2000)
cat('integration features', length(features), '\\n')
# use reciprocal PCA integration (fast)
obj1 <- ScaleData(obj1, features=features, verbose=FALSE)
obj2 <- ScaleData(obj2, features=features, verbose=FALSE)
obj1 <- RunPCA(obj1, features=features, npcs=30, verbose=FALSE)
obj2 <- RunPCA(obj2, features=features, npcs=30, verbose=FALSE)
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list=list(obj1,obj2), anchor.features=features, reduction='rpca', dims=1:30, k.anchor=5, verbose=TRUE)
integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset=anchors, dims=1:30, verbose=TRUE)
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- 'integrated'
integrated <- ScaleData(integrated, verbose=FALSE)
integrated <- RunPCA(integrated, npcs=30, verbose=FALSE)
integrated <- RunUMAP(integrated, reduction='pca', dims=1:30, verbose=FALSE)
integrated <- FindNeighbors(integrated, reduction='pca', dims=1:30, verbose=FALSE)
integrated <- FindClusters(integrated, resolution=0.8, verbose=FALSE)
saveRDS(integrated, 'integrated.rds')
cat('clusters\\n')
print(table(integrated"'$seurat_clusters, integrated$sample))
cat('"'done\\n')
EOF

)

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Seurat))
integrated <- readRDS('integrated.rds')
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- 'RNA'
expr <- GetAssayData(integrated, slot='data')
genes <- rownames(expr)
# function count cells with normalized expr > 0.5 or raw > 0
count_expr <- function(genes_vec, cutoff=0.5) {
 g <- genes_vec[genes_vec %in% genes]
 if(length(g)==0) return(rep(0,ncol(expr)))
 x <- as.matrix(expr[g,,drop=FALSE])
 Matrix::colSums(x >= cutoff) > 0
}
marker_groups <- list(
 Tcell=c('CD3D','CD3E','CD3G','TRAC','LCK','IL7R'),
 Bcell=c('MS4A1','CD79A','CD19','BANK1'),
 Microglia=c('C1QA','C1QB','C1QC','CSF1R','P2RY12','TYROBP','CX3CR1','AIF1'),
 Macrophage=c('CD163','MRC1','LYZ','FCGR3A','S100A8','S100A9'),
 RPE=c('RPE65','BEST1','TTR','PMEL','MLANA','DCT','SERPINF1'),
 Endothelial=c('PECAM1','VWF','CLDN5','FLT1','KDR','EGFL7'),
 Pericyte=c('PDGFRB','RGS5','NOTCH3','ACTA2','CSPG4'),
 Fibroblast=c('DCN','COL1A1','COL1A2','LUM','COL3A1','COL6A1','COL6A2','PDGFRA'),
 Schwann=c('MPZ','PLP1','MBP','SOX10','GAP43'),
 Astrocyte=c('GFAP','GJA1','ALDH1L1','AQP4'),
 Muller=c('RLBP1','GLUL','AQP4','SOX9','SLC1A3','CLU','DKK3'),
 Horizontal=c('ONECUT1','ONECUT2','LHX1','CALB1'),
 Amacrine=c('TFAP2A','GAD1','GAD2','SLC6A9','SLC32A1','CALB2'),
 Bipolar=c('VSX2','GRM6','TRPM1','ISL1','GRIK1','VSX1','LHX4'),
 RGC=c('RBPMS','SLC17A6','POU4F1','POU4F2','THY1','NEFL','NEFM','SNCG'),
 Cone=c('ARR3','GNAT2','PDE6H','OPN1SW','OPN1MW','OPN1LW'),
 Rod=c('RHO','NRL','NR2E3','GNAT1','PDE6B','SAG')
)
for(nm in names(marker_groups)){
 pos <- count_expr(marker_groups[[nm]], cutoff=0.5)
 tab <- table(integrated"'$sample[pos], integrated$seurat_clusters[pos])
 cat('"'\\n###', nm, 'positive cells by sample:', table(integrated"'$sample[pos]), '"'\\n')
 if(sum(pos)>0) print(tab)
 # list top clusters by positives
}
# Specifically horizontal markers distributions among cells with ONECUT1>1 etc
cat('\\nONECUT1 > 1 by sample and cluster\\n')
print(table(integrated"'$sample[expr['"'ONECUT1',] > 1], integrated"'$seurat_clusters[expr['"'ONECUT1',] > 1]))
cat('\\nLHX1 > 1 by sample and cluster\\n')
print(table(integrated"'$sample[expr['"'LHX1',] > 1], integrated"'$seurat_clusters[expr['"'LHX1',] > 1]))
cat('\\nONECUT1 >0.5 & LHX1 >0.5 by sample/cluster\\n')
mask <- expr['ONECUT1',] > 0.5 & expr['LHX1',] > 0.5
print(table(integrated"'$sample[mask], integrated$seurat_clusters[mask]))
cat('"'\\nT cell CD3D >0.5 by sample/cluster\\n')
mask <- expr['CD3D',] > 0.5
print(table(integrated"'$sample[mask], integrated$seurat_clusters[mask]))
EOF

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Seurat))
integrated <- readRDS('integrated.rds')
integrated[['RNA']] <- JoinLayers(integrated[['RNA']])
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- 'RNA'
markers <- c('RPE65','BEST1','TTR','PMEL','MLANA','DCT','TYRP1','SERPINF1','RGR','OTX1')
avg <- AverageExpression(integrated, assays='RNA', features=markers, group.by='seurat_clusters', slot='data')
mat <- as.matrix(avg"'$RNA)
print(round(mat,3))
# Cells with RPE65>0 and MLANA>0 etc
expr <- GetAssayData(integrated, assay='"'RNA', layer='data')
mask <- expr['RPE65',] > 0 & expr['MLANA',] > 0
cat('\\nRPE65>0 & MLANA>0 counts by sample/cluster\\n')
print(table(integrated"'$sample[mask], integrated$seurat_clusters[mask]))
mask2 <- expr['"'RPE65',] > 0.5 & (expr['MLANA',] > 0.5 | expr['PMEL',] > 0.5)
cat('\\nRPE65>.5 & (MLANA>.5|PMEL>.5)\\n')
print(table(integrated"'$sample[mask2], integrated$seurat_clusters[mask2]))
# expression values for all RPE65 positive cells sample and cluster
sub <- which(expr['"'RPE65',] > 0)
cat('RPE65 positive cells by sample', table(integrated"'$sample[sub]), '"'\\n')
print(round(head(sort(expr['RPE65',sub], decreasing=TRUE)),2))
EOF
